description: Reviews pasted copy and its content type against listed rules: buzzwords, claims that need proof, fragments, unfilled merge fields, claims about the reader and a missing figure or ask. Optional goal, audience and tone preference refine the review. Returns a score for each area with each deduction quoted from your text, and the edits it made. If it finds no edit to make, it says so and prints no improved version.

audience.description: Optional: who the content is for. The review reports when the text never mentions them

content_type.description: The kind of content; it changes which checks apply

goal.description: Optional: what the content should achieve (for example 'book a first meeting' or 'educate readers'). If not given, a goal is chosen from the content type

tone_preference.description: The tone you want. Only more_formal and more_casual are checked in the text; any other value is named in the answer as not used

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: craft_content_improver
title: CRAFT Content Improver
